newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 556c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator steady on 556c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator was steady on 556 cents a kg clean at sales in Newcastle, Adelaide and Launceston on Thursday, Wool International (WI) said in its daily market commentary.
Merino fleece prices were mixed, with the 19 micron indicator up to 1.0 percent cheaper and 20m 0.5 percent cheaper.
The 21/25/26m categories were slightly dearer, while 22/23m were 0.5 percent dearer. The 24m indicator was unchanged.
Merino skirtings were up to 1.0 percent dearer.
In crossbreds, 27m was slightly cheaper, 28m was 0.5 percent cheaper, 29/30m were unchanged and 31m was 1.0 percent dearer.
In cardings, locks and crutchings were generally unchanged.
WI said Japanese, Chinese and Western European interests were principal buyers with support from local mills and most sectors of the trade.
Of 25,742 bales offered, 12.9 percent were passed in.
Sales continue next week in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 143,766 bales to be offered.
